## Purpose / scope

Source-bound change summary and expected output:

## Evidence / review

- [ ] Exact base/head commit and provenance recorded.
- [ ] Inbound OSS license and third-party attributions retained.
- [ ] Original rights and permissions verified for any new asset.
- [ ] No private PACA/SIGIL core, secret, personal data or unconsented likeness exposed.
- [ ] Local tests/accessibility/content QA attached or marked NOT OBSERVED.
- [ ] `npm run policy:audit` performed, with a reproducible receipt or NOT OBSERVED.
- [ ] Package, website, game, PDF, GitHub Release and npm publication remain HOLD unless separately approved.
- [ ] Human copyright/security/release review explicitly recorded (never inferred from CI).

## Release disposition

`HOLD_PUBLIC_RELEASE` / `REVIEW_REQUIRED` / `READY_FOR_RELEASE` (select one and justify)

**Not a request to bypass a branch ruleset or publish artifacts.**
